Habitat V0.3.1

Changelog

  • Added: Mini games! Because why not?
  • Improved: Main Navigation. All tools are now listed on home page and tools tab turned into Score. A mini games section.
  • Improved: While screenshot selection or window is active, hitting space no longer effects background app you’re screenshotting.
  • Improved: Renamed Biscuits to Screen Tools, and a couple other features for better clarity.
  • Improved: Now able to edit another mouse’s buttons instead of active mouse in squeak settings.
  • Fixed: Recording a window now properly shows cursor after selecting it, and no longer keeps blue outline on top of window.
  • Fixed: Leap tool page scrolling brace was off compared to other tools inside Habitat.


    • More to come.

    — Thank you for all the support & feedback!
